name: Lovers Pavilion
description: Another sincere masterpiece in the Tianwaitian series. It entrusts the beautiful legend of the Weaver Girl looking at the Milky Way in the Acacia Pavilion and deeply missing the Cowherd. Product details such as the moon, begonias and red beans vividly render the acacia atmosphere. The color combination of green, white and gold shows elegance and beauty. Innovative suspended structure, equipped with a meniscus-shaped customized bracket, which can rotate freely with the wind, giving it a very oriental charm.
